court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Additional District Judge (Fast Track Court No.II), Cuddalore, OS No.109 of 2010

parties.respondent_defendant: V. Damodaran, Thamizhselvi, Thamizharasi, Saraswathi, Thamizharasan, Thamizhselvan — defendants

facts_of_case: Suit for partition laid by Kavitha claiming 1/3rd share in 'B' to 'E' Schedule properties. Plaintiff claimed ancestral properties inherited under a Will dated 29.02.1972 executed by Varadarasu Kounder.

legal_principles.principle: Section 16 of the Hindu Marriage Act can only be invoked when a marriage is proved and found to be void in view of Section 11.
legal_principles.held: According to him, Section 16 of the Hindu Marriage Act could be invoked only when a marriage is proved and such marriage is found to be void in view of Section 11 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: The testator's intention must be confined only to legitimate children and will not include illegitimate children.
legal_principles.held: He would also submit that the testator had specifically stated that the children of Damodaran would take the absolute estate on the death of Damodaran and that word children must be confined only to legitimate children and will not include illegitimate children.
cited_cases: N.Krishnammal v. R.Ekambaram and others, (1980) 1 MLJ 11(SC)

legal_principles.principle: A presumption of a valid marriage can be drawn in respect of the second marriage also.
legal_principles.held: He would also submit that even if there is no direct evidence for the marriage, the Court can presume a marriage on the basis of long cohabitation and on the evidence that is before the Court which would go long way to show that defendants 5 and 6 are the children of Saraswathi born through Damodaran.
cited_cases: S.P.S. Balasubramanyam v. Suruttayan alias Andali Padayachi and others, (1994) 1 SCC 460

outcome.final_order: The judgment and decree of the trial court partly dismissing the suit are set aside, and the appeal is allowed.

use_for_drafting: guidelines for Hindu Marriage Act cases
